data.title: Two men arrested in hunt for young Russian siblings
data.description: Police have arrested two Thai men while expanding the search for two missing Russian siblings in the Pattaya area, using sniffer dogs to look for clues.

data.title: TAO council chairman arrested with 400,000 speed pills on Mekong riverbank
data.description: NAKHON PHANOM - Authorities have arrested the chairman of a tambon administration organisation (TAO) in Tha Uthen district, finding him with 400,000 speed pills.

data.title: Foreign tourist to be deported after Hua Hin rampage
data.description: A Qatari man is facing deportation after a series of unprovoked attacks on six people — including dragging a woman from her wheelchair — during a violent outburst in Hua Hin.

data.title: 15 provinces warned of landslides, forest runoff
data.description: Residents in 15 Thai provinces, mostly in the North, are urged to be alert to possible landslides and forest runoff from Thursday to Saturday, according to the Department of Mineral Resources.

data.title: Fake dentist arrested after decade of practising
data.description: BURI RAM - Police have arrested a fake dentist and two others for running a dental clinic without a licence in Muang district of this northeastern province.

data.title: Transport ministry speeds up high-speed rail work
data.description: The Ministry of Transport is accelerating construction of the first phase of the Thai-Chinese high-speed rail project while preparing to launch bidding for the second phase, which will extend the line to Nong Khai and strengthen onnectivity with Laos and China to support regional trade, investment and economic growth.

data.title: Chiang Mai-Chiang Rai highway partially flooded but passable
data.description: Motorists on the main highway between Chiang Mai and Chiang Rai were being advised on Thursday to drive carefully as workers are draining floodwater from the surface in some locations.

data.title: Search continues for Russian siblings missing from Pattaya
data.description: The search continued on Thursday for two Russian siblings who have been missing from their house in Pattaya for five days, with police bringing in two sniffer dogs to assist in the mission.

data.title: Thailand awaits Georgian investigation of blogger’s death
data.description: Thai Foreign Minister Sihasak Phuangketkeow on Thursday expressed sadness on the passing of Thai travel YouTuber Hlun Solo in Georgia, saying the cause of death has yet to be concluded and is still under investigation.

data.title: Suicide attempts on Phuket bridges on successive days
data.description: PHUKET - Two women driving black Mercedes-Benz sedans have attempted suicide from bridges above the sea in Phuket on successive days. One was saved, the other has not been found.

data.title: EC defends backing 2 controversial candidates
data.description: The Election Commission (EC) has published its rulings explaining why two senators from Amnat Charoen were deemed qualified to contest the 2024 Senate election, following renewed calls by iLaw director Yingcheep Atchanont.

data.title: Democrat MP urges public against TH-AI Passport
data.description: Democrat MP Karndee Leopairote has called on the public to oppose the government's 1.621-billion-baht TH-AI Passport project, demanding greater transparency and value for taxpayers.

data.title: Airport Rail Link power outage fixed
data.description: An electrical problem that disrupted Airport Rail Link services on Thursday morning has been resolved, with trains returning to their normal schedules at 9.30am, the operator said .

data.title: OPDC eyes some branch office closures
data.description: The Office of the Public Sector Development Commission (OPDC) will propose closing provincial branch offices of state agencies as part of an overhaul of the public administration system.

data.title: AI strategy now 'falling behind'
data.description: Thailand must develop its own Thai-language AI systems or risk falling behind foreign technology companies, economists and digital policy experts have warned.

data.title: Water security fears grow
data.description: A series of emerging reports in recent weeks concerning tight water supplies and river pollution in central and northern Thailand mean the nation is now facing a challenging water security situation, experts say.

data.title: Ministry pushes Chumphon-Ranong rail
data.description: The Transport Ministry has pushed for the Chumphon-Ranong double-track railway project, describing the 110-kilometre route as a missing link needed to connect Thailand's rail network with an Andaman Sea port.

data.title: Flood diversion canal hits new flak
data.description: A civic network in Nakhon Nayok is stepping up its campaign against the proposed Pasak–Gulf of Thailand flood diversion canal, accusing authorities of misrepresenting the outcome of public consultations and downplaying strong local resistance to the project.

data.title: Dialogue offers path to peace
data.description: Manila: Thailand and Cambodia should engage more at diplomatic levels to resolve ongoing conflicts, said Asean secretary-general Kao Kim Hourn.

data.title: No Thais hurt in Japan quake
data.description: The Foreign Affairs Ministry has activated emergency contact channels for Thai citizens in Japan following the magnitude 7.1 earthquake that struck Kumamoto Prefecture on Tuesday.

data.title: Asean envoy plans to visit Myanmar
data.description: Manila: Theresa P Lazaro, secretary of foreign affairs of the Philippines and the Asean Chair's Special Envoy on Myanmar, said she is scheduled to make a humanitarian visit to Myanmar in the fourth quarter of this year.
